pre_registered.note: The mutation battery is PRE-REGISTERED here and runs AFTER the executor finishes, against the landed tree. It is a controller/evaluator act, not executor work. Every arm: cp -p backup, sed with an asserted occurrence count, sha256 landed-proof (pre != post), a compile/vet assert BEFORE any test result is read, the scoped observable read (never the exit code alone), the named test required as the SOLE failure, then restore by cp from the .bak — restore asserted by shasum -a 256 equality AND test -x where a mode bit matters — and NEVER git checkout -- (the tree may be dirty; a checkout would silently discard unrelated work).

pre_registered.restore_discipline: cp <file> <file>.bak && sed -i '...' <file>; <run target test>; restore cp <file>.bak <file>; restore asserted by shasum -a 256 <file> == pre-mutation digest AND test -x <file> where a mode bit matters (the .bak is cp -p so the mode bit survives); never git checkout --

features.name: host/authority package + store schema v3 (mint/resolve/revoke primitives, D2 D3 D5)
features.description: New host/authority package owning mint, resolve, and denial: Resolver interface, four-kind DenialKind taxonomy, ResolveOutcome (typed, never nil-outcome-on-non-error), SessionBinding{EpisodeID, Caps, ExpiresAt, CreatedAt} with no credential hash exposed, FromContext typed-context accessor. Mint: crypto/rand 32 bytes -> 64 lowercase hex, store persists sha256(token_hex) only, raw token printed exactly once (or --out at mode 0600). Resolve: hash-then-index — sha256 of the presented token into exactly one indexed SELECT ... WHERE credential_id = ? on the PK; no crypto/subtle anywhere (a post-hit compare would be vacuous); absent short-circuits before any store touch. Revoke: DELETE in a transaction (delete-from-mapping = unknown). Store: append session_credentials DDL verbatim from the round-2 quorum fix (no revoked column, NO secondary index), currentSchemaVersion 2->3, MintSession/ResolveSession/RevokeSession methods, and — travelling with this milestone per DEF-3 — expectedCurrentSchemaVersion 2->3, frozenFutureSchemaVersion 3->4, the v3 migration row, and non-vacuous journal fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: AC-M1-3 resolve returns episode+grants+expiry. Resolve("Bearer <token>", now<expires) -> Success with EpisodeID==e1, Caps matching the minted grant, ExpiresAt==mint+3600. Resolve NEVER returns the raw token.
AC-M2-1 (resolver half) absent header. Resolve("", now) -> DenialAbsent.

AC-M2-2 (resolver half) malformed header. Resolve("Key abc", ...) and Resolve("Bearer", ...) and Resolve("Bearer z" /*1 char*/, ...) -> DenialMalformed. A non-64-hex token is malformed, never unknown.
AC-M2-3 (resolver half) unknown token. Resolve("Bearer deadbeef...64hex-unknown", ...) -> DenialUnknown. The static serve-api key value as Bearer -> DenialUnknown (constraint (i) — never a session).
AC-M2-4 (resolver half) expired. Mint with --ttl 1, sleep 2, resolve -> DenialExpired, distinct from DenialUnknown.
AC-M2-5 (store/resolver half) revocation. RevokeSession(<credential_id-hash>) deletes the row, then resolve of the same token -> DenialUnknown (delete-from-mapping = unknown, D4).

AC-M2-6 (resolver half) no alternate-header fallback. The resolver reads ONLY the Authorization value; a credential presented via any other carrier is DenialAbsent (HTTP carrier assertion lands at M2).

AC-M3-1 no direct secret comparison. A source-scan test over host/authority/*.go FAILS if any direct equality (==, bytes.Equal, strings.EqualFold, strings.Contains) is applied to token or credential-hash material. Killers: mutation M1.
AC-M3-2 bounded lookup. The resolve path issues exactly one SQL query: a counting observer on the store/DB seam asserts query count == 1 with the single indexed SELECT ... WHERE credential_id = ?.

AC-M4-3 store schema bump: a v2 store DB opened by the new binary is refused (LegacySchemaVersionError); a fresh DB initializes at v3 and the migrate row/constraints in schema_version_test.go are updated and green.

Exit gates (all with AILANG_BIN=$HOME/.pinned-ailang/ailang): go vet ./... rc=0; go test ./host/authority/... -count=1 ok; go test ./... -count=1 -> 20 ok / 0 FAIL; bash ./scripts/verify_ail.sh unchanged (11 identities, 40 tests, 9/9 steps).
Snapshot: every created-or-modified file copied into .snap/M1/ (full content).
traps: schema.sql: NO secondary CREATE INDEX (round-2 quorum fix; DEF-1) — the PRIMARY KEY already carries the point-lookup index AC-M3-2 bounds.

Three version constants move TOGETHER (currentSchemaVersion, expectedCurrentSchemaVersion, frozenFutureSchemaVersion 3->4) plus one v3 migration row; moving fewer reds host/store at schema_version_test.go:19.
The source-scan test must scan token/credential-hash material only — a scan that reds on any == in the package would false-positive on unrelated comparisons.
Absent must short-circuit BEFORE the store is touched (bounded by construction, D5); a resolve that queries on an empty header breaks AC-M3-2's count==1.
Mint output: exactly one raw-token occurrence — the one-line confirmation carries episode, grant count, expiry epoch, path; never the credential.
host/authority imports host/broker one-way; it must NOT import host/daemon (round-2 fix; that is why the middleware lives in the daemon package at M2).

features.name: session mint|revoke CLI verbs + tty fence (D1 D4) + daemon middleware + handleCommit session binding (D6 D7)
features.description: Operator-facing verbs on the established flag CLI: session mint --episode <id> [--grant EFFECT=SCOPE:BUDGET]... [--ttl 3600] [--out <path>] and session revoke <credential_id-hash>, dispatched via case "session" in main.go's switch verb, talking DIRECTLY to the store DB path (--db, default matching serve --db) — never a new HTTP endpoint (daemon-owned mint is residual R13). Tty fence ported from cmd/world-publish/tty.go: refuse with no controlling terminal (os.Open("/dev/tty") ENXIO), Y/N confirmation read from /dev/tty. Daemon side (round-2 quorum placement): host/daemon/middleware.go SessionMiddleware.Wrap(protected, mux) calling in-package writeAPIError — absent/unknown/expired -> 401 with distinct classes SessionAbsent/SessionUnknown/SessionExpired, malformed -> 400 InvalidSession; success -> typed context value read via authority.FromContext. Handler() wraps the mux; protected = POST /v1/commit only (eight GET routes unauthenticated this sprint — residual R1, a config flip later). handleCommit reads the binding and builds broker.NewSession(d.store, binding.EpisodeID, binding.Caps, registry); store Commit semantics unchanged; effect-ledger re-record is residual R3. X-World-Session is never read anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: AC-M1-1 mint prints exactly once. ailang-worldd session mint --db <tmp>/world.db --episode e1 --grant fs.read=/tmp/b:1 --ttl 3600 under a PTTY (test drives os.Open("/dev/tty") via the fencing seam) -> prints the raw 64-hex token exactly once and stores one row. Count raw-token occurrences in the output: exactly 1.
AC-M1-2 distinct credentials per mint. Mint twice for the same episode; the two printed tokens differ (and both rows have distinct credential_id). test "$a" != "$b" -> 0 (distinct).
AC-M2-1 (HTTP half) POST /v1/commit with no Authorization -> 401 SessionAbsent.
AC-M2-2 (HTTP half) malformed header -> 400 InvalidSession. A non-64-hex token is malformed -> 400, never 401.
AC-M2-3 (HTTP half) unknown token -> 401 SessionUnknown. The static serve-api key value as Bearer -> 401 (constraint (i) — never a session).
AC-M2-4 (HTTP half) expired -> 401 SessionExpired, distinct from SessionUnknown.
AC-M2-5 (CLI half) session revoke <credential_id-hash> then resolve of the same token -> DenialUnknown (delete-from-mapping = unknown, D4).
AC-M2-6 (HTTP half) no alternate-header fallback. Request with ONLY X-World-Session: <a valid minted token> and no Authorization -> 401 SessionAbsent (must NOT resolve).
AC-M4-1 go test ./... -count=1 -> 19 ok or better (20 expected: 19 base + host/authority). go vet ./... -> rc=0.

AC-M4-2 bash ./scripts/verify_ail.sh with AILANG_BIN=$HOME/.pinned-ailang/ailang -> '✓ verify gate PASSED: 11 required identities verified, 40 named tests pass' and '✓ world package gate PASSED: 9/9 steps' (unchanged — this item adds no .ail).
AC-M4-3 re-proved at this exit: v2 store refused (LegacySchemaVersionError); fresh DB at v3; schema_version_test.go migrate row/constraints green.
Full AC battery green including the resolver-level ACs landed at M1 (AC-M1-3, AC-M3-1, AC-M3-2) — M2's exit re-runs all of design-doc §4.
Snapshot: every created-or-modified file copied into .snap/M2/ (cumulative — includes M1's files, full content). Executor STOPS here; the pre-registered mutation battery is the controller's next act.
traps: The tty fence is the controlling-terminal fence (os.Open("/dev/tty") ENXIO), NOT an isatty heuristic — /dev/null IS a character device and a naive ModeCharDevice check admits it (measured in cmd/world-publish/tty.go's header).
The PTTY AC (AC-M1-1) drives the fence through its seam in-process; any verdict that requires a process actually serving a socket is UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX — label it, never report pass/fail.
session mint takes --db, never --addr: it must not depend on a running daemon and must not cross the HTTP surface it authorizes.
Middleware lives in host/daemon and writes errors via the in-package writeAPIError; host/authority must not import host/daemon (round-2 import-cycle fix).

handleCommit keeps the store's Commit semantics unchanged — the session is the capability/budget gate between the HTTP body and the store write; do NOT re-record the commit into the effect ledger (residual R3, row 40's).
Never read X-World-Session — not as fallback, not as preference (D-WORLD-26; killed by mutation M6).
The benchmark host/daemon/bench_test.go:474 calls broker.NewSession directly with a literal grant — the new session layer must not change its behavior (design doc §6).
